mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.instrument_id, s.trade_date, s.rule_code, s.rule_version, s.severity, s.evidence_json, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.is_synthetic FROM signal_event s JOIN instrument i ON i.id=s.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND s.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.select: ORDER BY trade_date DESC, rule_code LIMIT 1000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signal_event(instrument_id, trade_date, rule_code, rule_version, severity, evidence_json, status, is_synthetic) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{ruleCode}, #{ruleVersion}, #{severity}, #{evidenceJson}, #{status}, #{synthetic}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE severity= VALUES(severity), evidence_json= VALUES(evidence_json), status= VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE id=#{instrumentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id,r.instrument_id,r.trade_date,r.rule_code,r.rule_version,r.severity,r.status,r.evidence_json,r.parameters_json,r.content_hash,r.recorded_at,r.is_synthetic AS synthetic FROM signal_revision r JOIN instrument i ON i.id=r.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND r.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND r.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.recorded_at < DATE_ADD(r.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signal_revision n WHERE n.instrument_id=r.instrument_id AND n.trade_date=r.trade_date AND n.rule_code=r.rule_code AND n.rule_version=r.rule_version AND n.is_synthetic=r.is_synthetic AND n.recorded_at < DATE_ADD(n.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (n.recorded_at > r.recorded_at OR (n.recorded_at=r.recorded_at AND n.id > r.id))) ORDER BY r.trade_date,r.rule_code,r.id
